info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: waitlistMode reports whether one host is behind its service's waitlist.
get.description:
waitlistMode reports whether one host is behind its service's waitlist. It resolves
host→service through the launch registry, then reads the waitlist.<service> switch.
Public (in-cluster) read: it answers for the ONE queried host and never enumerates
the registry. An empty host falls back to the host the request was sent to.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description:
Host is the hostname to resolve, e.g. "chat.hanzo.ai". Empty means the
host the request itself was sent to.

host.description: Host is the normalized (lowercased, port-stripped) host that was resolved.

known.description: Known is false when no registry entry claims the host.

service.description: Service is the registry service governing that host, empty when unknown.

waitlistMode.description: WaitlistMode is true when the service is gated behind its waitlist.
